annotation.authors_or_issuer: 深圳市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee)
key_provisions_or_claims: Promotes low-altitude economy (manned and unmanned aircraft) with principles of safety first, innovation-driven, inclusive and prudent supervision
Municipal coordination mechanism, expert committee, low-altitude flight service platform and digital airspace map
Requires operating licences, airworthiness approval, aircraft registration and integration of drone data into regulatory platforms
Mandatory liability insurance; data security and privacy duties; incident reporting; ban on unlawful counter-drone equipment
Financial, talent, testing base and standards support for industry innovation
named_instruments_referenced: 中华人民共和国民用航空法
无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例
annotation.summary_en: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Regulations on Promoting the Low-Altitude Economy Industry, adopted 29 Dec 2023, effective 1 Feb 2024. It promotes drone and low-altitude aircraft industry through infrastructure, flight services, applications, financial support and innovation, while setting safety, licensing, registration, insurance, data security and counter-drone rules.

annotation.title_en: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Regulations on Promoting the Low-Altitude Economy Industry
